thread:
incident-bot: ⚠️ ALERT: cont-batching controlplane (us-east-1) detected elevated tail latencies and paging errors. cont_batch_p99 > 1.1s, kv_cache.eviction_rate 9.8x baseline. Auto-pageback triggered. Paging eng-oncall.

lee (eng-oncall): Oncall here, starting triage. Any recent config changes or rollouts in the last hour?

omar (eng-runtime): We pushed a tuning commit ~40m ago: changed default max_batch_tokens to 6144 and bumped max_num_seqs to 256 to improve throughput for large seqs. Also increased batching.window_ms to 80.

julia (sre): Seeing a large increase in concurrent KV page fetches and host disk IO. Several kvcache shards showing eviction storms; client RPC timeouts climbing. Likely oversized batches causing working set blowout and thrashing.

nina (ml-infra): GPU memory pressure is high on a subset of nodes and host page-in latency for KV page fetch jumped from ~3ms -> ~150ms at the p99. A few kernels saw long stall times.

ben (support): Multiple customers reported degraded throughput and many 504 timeouts ~25m ago. Tickets #C-5180, #C-5181. They reported an initial spike then partial recovery.

lee (eng-oncall): Initial mitigation options: A) rollback batch tuning commit B) apply emergency runtime override to cap batching C) apply admission-control throttle for non-paid tiers. I prefer a targeted override to avoid full rollback. Thoughts?

omar (eng-runtime): I can apply an emergency config override. Proposal for hotfix: set max_batch_tokens=1536, max_num_seqs=32, batching.window_ms=25, request_timeout_ms=5000, kv_cache.ttl_seconds=180. Also enable per-shard max_batch_tokens to avoid cross-shard mega-batches.

julia (sre): Recommend canary at 10% first, watch eviction rate and host IO. If stable, expand to 40% then full. Also set an admission token bucket to shed best-effort traffic at 50% to relieve pressure.

omar (eng-runtime): Patching canary group now. Command:

```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap cont-batch-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_tokens":"1536","max_num_seqs":"32","window_ms":"25","request_timeout_ms":"5000","kv_cache_ttl":"180","per_shard_max_batch":"true"}}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: configmap patched for canary pool (10%). Rollout started.

lee (eng-oncall): Observing metrics for 120s. Julia/Ben, can you watch customer signals and error pages?

nina (ml-infra): Canary metrics after 2m: cont_batch_p99 down to ~480ms, error_rate down to 2.1% on canary nodes, kv_cache.evictions dropped ~5x. Host IO p99 improved. No OOMs.

ben (support): Reached out to affected customers, one confirmed improvement for canary routed traffic. They still see intermittent slow responses on unaffected nodes.

omar (eng-runtime): Widening to 40% now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config patch applied to 40% pool.

julia (sre): On widening, I'm closely watching disk io and RPC tail. If any host crosses swap threshold, we halt. Also enabling temporary admission-control for best-effort traffic.

lee (eng-oncall): Admission control in place. Dropping non-SLA traffic by 60% until stable.

ops-bot: admission-controller: best-effort throttle enabled for region us-east-1.

nina (ml-infra): After widening: cluster-wide cont_batch_p99 ~360ms, error_rate ~0.8%, kv evictions baseline restored. Host memory stabilized and page-in latency dropped.

omar (eng-runtime): Rolling to global now and marking change as interim safe config. Applying global patch.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config rolled to 100% pool.

lee (eng-oncall): Post-deploy numbers look good. Setting incident INC-3033 (sev2) and taking notes. We'll keep incident open for postmortem and followups.

zoe (product): Preparing customer comms: "We have applied a temporary configuration change to stabilize performance while we investigate root cause. We will follow with a permanent remediation and timeline." Will coordinate with legal.

omar (eng-runtime): Quick follow-ups I will own: create a regression test matrix for batch parameters and add automated checks to prevent config combos that exceed per-shard memory heuristics.

julia (sre): I'll run root cause analysis: correlate model sequence distributions, recent traffic patterns, and config change. Also add an alert for kv_cache.eviction_rate over 3x baseline.

nina (ml-infra): I'll run a capacity scan and propose per-model/ per-shard adaptive caps. Also explore smoothing eviction backoff to avoid synchronized evictions.

ben (support): I'll update tickets and confirm once customers report stable performance.

lee (eng-oncall): Handoff: julia will be incident lead for follow-up. I'll update the incident doc with timelines and metrics and assign the action owners. Closing immediate mitigation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-bot: INC-3033 updated: mitigation applied, traffic stabilized, severity remains sev2 pending postmortem.
